POV: you finally made soft ragi buns that aren’t dry 👀✨ Eggless, high protein, gluten-free & honestly SO satisfying 🤍 Save this healthy buns recipe! Eggless High-Protein Ragi Buns Ingredients (4 buns) * 1 cup ragi (finger millet) flour * ¼ cup psyllium husk * ¼ cup high-protein Greek yogurt * 1 tsp baking powder or Eno * 1 tsp vinegar, 1 tbsp olive oil * Salt to taste * 1.5 cups water * Seeds / everything bagel seasoning (for topping) ⸻ 👩‍🍳 Method 1. In a mixing bowl, add ragi flour, psyllium husk, Greek yogurt, baking powder (or Eno), salt, vinegar, and water all at once. 2. Mix gently—within a few seconds, the mixture will start thickening into a soft dough-like texture. 3. Line a baking tray with parchment paper. 4. Divide the dough into 4 portions. 5. Lightly oil or wet your hands and shape into buns (the dough is slightly sticky). 6. Place on the tray and sprinkle your favorite seeds or everything bagel seasoning. 7. Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 40 minutes. 8. Once baked, remove and cover with a clean cloth for 15–20 minutes—this step makes them soft and fluffy. For the air fryer: * Preheat at 170°C for 3–5 minutes * Air fry the ragi buns at 170°C for 18–22 minutes #rag#ragibunsa#healthyrecipesg#highproteinu#glutenfreeglessrecipes
